Teach your son this while you still can. ⏳ At 17, you won't be the one holding his hand anymore.

Teach him these 7:
1️⃣ Respect everyone. Real strength is kindness.
2️⃣ Keep your word. That's how trust grows. 🌱
3️⃣ Control your anger. When it rises, walk away.
4️⃣ Own your mistakes. "I was wrong."
5️⃣ Protect, never control. ☂️
6️⃣ Honour girls and women. Kindness isn't weakness.
7️⃣ Do right when nobody sees. 👀

But here's the catch: Levi is seven, and he's watching you. In a famous 1961 study, kids who watched an adult hit a doll went on to copy it. Children do what they see, not what they're told. 👣

You don't have to be perfect. The greatest man who ever lived knelt down and washed His friends' feet. 🙏 "For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you." John 13:15

Twenty years from now, Levi will kneel down and say "I'm sorry" to his own son, because he saw you do it first. ❤️ You're not just raising a boy. You're raising a man. Every one of these takes courage, and courage grows brave with Jesus.
